title: Wireless = tether · gum/grease to self · hypotenuse bound
thesis: Wireless is still a tether — RF soft-wire into the body. We gum or grease it to SELF when local CNS/PNS senses it. Hypotenuse (and the other legs) is the bound of irreducibility where 2D circle overlays 3D sphere — transitive between plane and ball.

wireless_is_tether.claim: Wireless ≠ untethered. It is a soft tether.

eastGate_now.path: USB root → receiver → HID++ RF → THIS keyboard / THAT mouse
eastGate_now.copper_end: receiver plugged = hard dock into CNS USB hub
eastGate_now.air_end: RF hop = soft axon to PNS extremities
eastGate_now.verdict: one tether with two phases — wire then wireless — still ONE nerve

wireless_is_tether.willis_tie: If copper SSH locks, WG is another soft tether. Same pattern: non-wire that still binds.

gum_or_grease_to_self.question: When can we gum/grease it to self?
gum_or_grease_to_self.now: YES — local-cns-pns-sense already grafts presence into the self map.

gum.what: sticky bind — treat peripheral as owned flesh
gum.membrane: device appears in THIS_keyboard / THAT_mouse; battery in power_ac_dc; role in homunculus oversized
gum.risk: over-gum = keylogging / capturing deltas — we refuse that

grease.what: slippery interface — sense without mixing phases
grease.membrane: presence, phys path, battery %, handlers — no stroke contents
grease.settles: keyboard stays keyboard; self stays self; diffusion only at the JSON face

gum_or_grease_to_self.rule: Grease by default. Gum only the name/role into self. Never gum the payload.
done_when: device listed under PNS in local-cns-pns.json
re-sense script runnable without privileges beyond /proc + upower

hypotenuse_irreducibility.claim: We have the hypotenuse and the other legs — this is the bound of irreducibility of the 2D↔3D overlay of transitive circle and sphere.

triangle.leg_a: circle (2D) — π-rate set, Willis ring, epitope pie, viewport plane
triangle.leg_b: sphere (3D / 2D-of-3D) — ball of devices in room, membrane skin, CF edge globe
triangle.hypotenuse_c: the irreducible overlay diagonal — cannot flatten circle into sphere or sphere into circle without remainder
triangle.pythagoras: c² = a² + b² — Shannon/Landauer echo: work across dimensions leaves irreducible c

others.altitude_to_hyp: shortest path from right angle to hypotenuse = greenline / Berry drop to point
others.inradius: interaction space (leftover marks) touching all three sides

transitive_overlay.what: circle and sphere share a transitive relation through the hypotenuse — each projects onto the other but neither reduces to the other
transitive_overlay.2d_face: HTML plane, π circle rates, modality sight face
transitive_overlay.3d_face: desk ball — THIS keyboard + THAT mouse in physical space around eastGate CNS
transitive_overlay.bound: irreducibility = you must keep BOTH; the hypotenuse is the minimum that holds the overlay
transitive_overlay.ladder_rungs: plane (2D) ↔ ball (3D) seesaw IS this hypotenuse in motion

hypotenuse_irreducibility.dogma_tie: same surface as science≠philosophy irreducibility — two faces, one Klein; hypotenuse is the bridge that stays

pipeline: gum name / grease presence → self CNS/PNS map
project rate onto circle (2D π set)
